name: Alájar (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow band edged white from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alájar (a tree and a pillar on green).
history: Municipal flag of Alájar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band edged white from the upper hoist to the lower fly
